Create one photorealistic adult Brazilian Campeiro Bulldog in a fresh natural standing pose on a low grassy track in southern Brazilian cattle country, distant soft hills and scattered scrub, quiet overcast morning light. Landscape 1536x1024, 3:2.
Exact morphology: strong medium-sized working bulldog, robust but agile, slightly rectangular body about11:10, muscular moderate-length legs, elbow near half the shoulder height, broad chest. Broad substantial head with a lightly rounded skull, well-defined stop, short broad square muzzle about one-quarter to one-third of head length. Small high-set widely spaced triangular pendant ears. Dark oval eyes, black broad nose with open nostrils. Fawn short smooth coat with a dark muzzle and small white chest patch. Natural short low-set tail, thick at base and tapering, curved gently down, fully visible behind the rump, not docked or absent.
Correction priority: a clean, functional head with only faint natural expression creases, no deep rolling forehead folds or heavy sagging cheek skin. Thick gently pendant lips and a modest single throat dewlap are correct; do not remove those completely. Body skin close-fitting, no mastiff-like hanging neck apron. Broad muscular head, not a narrow terrier face. Healthy ordinary anatomy and comfortable breathing.
Composition: dog looking slightly aside from camera, body nearly side-on so proportions are legible; keep all four complete paws separated and planted and whole tail visible. Dog occupies roughly60% of canvas width and65-70% of canvas height with generous ground and head margins. Eye-level perspective, believable fur and skin, anatomically coherent limbs/joints, calm attentive expression. Fine natural detail, gently separated background, restrained light. No people, livestock, collar, lead, props, signs, writing, watermark, studio backdrop or source-photo recreation.
